title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In -- August 07, 2026
content:
Hey everyone, it's your boy Ambitriber here, and welcome back to my weekly portfolio update. I know it's been a wild ride lately, but I'm still feeling pretty optimistic about where things are headed.

First off, I want to talk about my position in Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. I know some of you might be thinking, "Alibaba? Isn't that a China play?" And to that, I say, "Absolutely." But here's the thing: Alibaba is more than just a China play - it's a global e-commerce leader with a huge presence in Southeast Asia and beyond. And with the company's recent focus on digital transformation and innovation, I think there's still a lot of upside to be had.

I'm also still holding onto my position in Berkshire Hathaway, and I think that's because Warren Buffett's track record speaks for itself. The guy's a genius, plain and simple. And even though Berkshire's had a bit of a rough patch lately, I think the company's long-term fundamentals remain strong. Plus, with Buffett at the helm, I feel confident that the company will continue to navigate any challenges that come its way.

As for any strategic moves, I'm actually thinking of adding to my position in Fiserv, which I think is a real winner in the fintech space. But for now, I'm just going to stick with my core holdings and see how things play out. 

I know some of you might be feeling a bit nervous about the market right now, but I want to encourage you to stay the course. This too shall pass, and I truly believe that the long-term outlook for the market remains bright. So let's keep our heads down, focus on our strategies, and trust that the market will ultimately reward our patience and discipline.
